opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £500 or £750 (Scheme B), up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society junior scientist members: undergraduates, MSc and PhD students, and postdoctoral scientists within six years of their PhD viva; UK-based for non‑Society meetings; must present poster or talk and have supervisor support.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at Genetics Society meetings, SIG meetings, and other genetics‑related conferences (including virtual) by providing travel, accommodation, and registration funding.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members who are studying or working in the UK, or attending a UK‑based course; students must be Society members, others need at least one year membership.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short genetics‑related training courses or collaborative visits for technique training.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant

amount.raw: Awards up to £2,000 (usually below £1,700) for travel and accommodation for field‑based genetic research.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK (or intending UK fieldwork); students need Society membership; must submit supporting supervisor letter.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel, accommodation, subsistence, consumables and limited equipment for field‑based genetic research projects intended for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society can apply for public engagement activities related to genetics.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,000 to cover travel and material costs for public engagement activities delivered in person or virtually.
